name: Sunway Real Estate Investment Trust
overview: 2026年，Sunway Real Estate Investment Trust 的业务板块没有出现扩张、新增、缩减或出售的公告，主要公告涉及季度业绩、收入分配和股东大会等常规事项。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收为225,279,000令吉，同比下降3.3%；净利润为122,008,000令吉，同比下降4.4%。
overview_en: In 2026, Sunway Real Estate Investment Trust did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment for its business segments; key announcements were routine matters such as quarterly results, income distributions, and general meetings. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was MYR 225,279,000, down 3.3% year-on-year, and net profit was MYR 122,008,000, down 4.4% year-on-year.
